mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, author_names, description, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'BOOK', b.id, b.slug, b.title, b.cover_image_url, (SELECT STRING_AGG(a.name, ', ' ORDER BY a.name) FROM book_authors ba JOIN authors a ON ba.author_id = a.id WHERE ba.book_id = b.id), b.description, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.raw_score * COALESCE(quality.quality_multiplier, 1.0) AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.raw_score * COALESCE(quality.quality_multiplier, 1.0) DESC, b.id ASC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT book_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_key) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE action_type WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'read' THEN #{readWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - day_bucket)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS raw_score FROM ( -- Dedup: satu (viewer, action_type, hari) dihitung sekali, -- mencegah refresh berulang menggelembungkan skor SELECT book_id, action_type, COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash) AS viewer_key, date_trunc('day', viewed_at) AS day_bucket FROM book_views WHERE viewed_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY book_id, action_type, COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash), date_trunc('day', viewed_at) ) deduped GROUP BY book_id ) agg JOIN books b ON b.id = agg.book_id AND b.is_active = true LEFT JOIN ( SELECT br.book_id, -- Bayesian-adjusted rating, dinormalisasi ke multiplier terbatas -- supaya kualitas mempengaruhi urutan tanpa membalik traffic secara ekstrem #{qualityMin} + (#{qualityMax} - #{qualityMin}) * ( (COUNT(*) * AVG(br.rating) + #{qualityMinRatings} * 3.5) / (COUNT(*) + #{qualityMinRatings}) / 5.0 ) AS quality_multiplier FROM book_ratings br WHERE br.rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY br.book_id ) quality ON quality.book_id = b.id ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, author_names, description, subtitle, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'ZINE', z.id, z.slug, z.title, z.cover_image_url, z.first_publisher, z.description, z.subtitle, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.raw_score * COALESCE(quality.quality_multiplier, 1.0) AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.raw_score * COALESCE(quality.quality_multiplier, 1.0) DESC, z.id ASC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT zine_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_key) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE action_type WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'read' THEN #{readWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - day_bucket)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS raw_score FROM ( SELECT zine_id, action_type, COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash) AS viewer_key, date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day_bucket FROM zine_views WHERE created_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY zine_id, action_type, COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash), date_trunc('day', created_at) ) deduped GROUP BY zine_id ) agg JOIN zines z ON z.id = agg.zine_id AND z.is_active = true LEFT JOIN ( SELECT zr.zine_id, #{qualityMin} + (#{qualityMax} - #{qualityMin}) * ( (COUNT(*) * AVG(zr.rating) + #{qualityMinRatings} * 3.5) / (COUNT(*) + #{qualityMinRatings}) / 5.0 ) AS quality_multiplier FROM zine_ratings zr WHERE zr.rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY zr.zine_id ) quality ON quality.zine_id = z.id ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, poster_portrait_url, release_year, description, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'FILM', f.id, f.slug, f.judul, f.poster_url, f.poster_portrait_url, f.tahun_rilis, f.deskripsi, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.raw_score AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.raw_score DESC, f.id ASC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT film_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_key) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE action_type WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - day_bucket)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS raw_score FROM ( SELECT film_id, action_type, COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash) AS viewer_key, date_trunc('day', viewed_at) AS day_bucket FROM film_views WHERE viewed_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY film_id, action_type, COALESCE(user_id::text, viewer_hash), date_trunc('day', viewed_at) ) deduped GROUP BY film_id ) agg JOIN film f ON f.id = agg.film_id ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}

INSERT INTO trending_weekly (content_type, content_id, slug, title, cover_image_url, view_count, download_count, unique_viewers, score, rank_position, computed_at) SELECT 'NEWSPAPER', ns.id, ns.slug, ns.name, ns.logo_url, agg.view_count, agg.download_count, agg.unique_viewers, agg.raw_score AS score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY agg.raw_score DESC, ns.id ASC), NOW() FROM ( SELECT source_id, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'view') AS view_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action_type = 'download') AS download_count, COUNT(DISTINCT viewer_key) AS unique_viewers, SUM( CASE action_type WHEN 'download' THEN #{downloadWeight} WHEN 'view' THEN #{viewWeight} ELSE 0 END * POWER(2, - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - day_bucket)) / (86400.0 * #{halfLifeDays})) ) AS raw_score FROM ( SELECT na.source_id, av.action_type::text AS action_type, COALESCE(av.user_id::text, av.viewer_hash) AS viewer_key, date_trunc('day', av.created_at) AS day_bucket FROM article_views av JOIN newspaper_articles na ON na.id = av.article_id AND na.is_active = true WHERE av.created_at >= NOW() - (#{days}::text || ' days')::interval GROUP BY na.source_id, av.action_type::text, COALESCE(av.user_id::text, av.viewer_hash), date_trunc('day', av.created_at) ) deduped GROUP BY source_id ) agg JOIN newspaper_sources ns ON ns.id = agg.source_id AND ns.is_active = true ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.select: SELECT content_type AS contentType, content_id AS contentId, slug, title, subtitle, cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, poster_portrait_url AS posterPortraitUrl, author_names AS authorNames, release_year AS releaseYear, description, source_slug AS sourceSlug, view_count AS viewCount, download_count AS downloadCount, unique_viewers AS uniqueViewers, score, normalized_score AS normalizedScore, rank_position AS rankPosition, computed_at AS computedAt FROM trending_weekly WHERE content_type = #{contentType} ORDER BY rank_position ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT content_type AS contentType, content_id AS contentId, slug, title, subtitle, cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, poster_portrait_url AS posterPortraitUrl, author_names AS authorNames, release_year AS releaseYear, description, source_slug AS sourceSlug, view_count AS viewCount, download_count AS downloadCount, unique_viewers AS uniqueViewers, score, normalized_score AS normalizedScore, rank_position AS rankPosition, computed_at AS computedAt FROM trending_weekly WHERE rank_position <= #{limitPerType} ORDER BY content_type ASC, rank_position ASC

SELECT content_type AS contentType, content_id AS contentId, slug, title, subtitle, cover_image_url AS coverImageUrl, poster_portrait_url AS posterPortraitUrl, author_names AS authorNames, release_year AS releaseYear, description, source_slug AS sourceSlug, view_count AS viewCount, download_count AS downloadCount, unique_viewers AS uniqueViewers, score, normalized_score AS normalizedScore, rank_position AS rankPosition, computed_at AS computedAt FROM trending_weekly ORDER BY score DESC, content_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
